verdict.rationale: Docs confirm developers configure AI Model Provider entities with their own provider credentials, with centralized credential management, and can store keys via env vars, literal values, or an AI Vault backend (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault) rather than Kong-managed keys; provider-specific setup (e.g., Anthropic) is documented. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of BYO-key setup working end-to-end, and no explicit mention of per-user/per-tenant key overrides at request time.
